previous.source: M2 QA report: dist JS 400.74 kB gzip as printed by `vite build`. Vite's figure runs about 1% above this script's (Node default-level gzip), so M2 is not directly comparable with `baseline`; with Vite's own numbers M3 was 436.53 kB, 35.8 kB above M2.

notes: The budget is per milestone: CI fails when the built JS (or CSS) gzip is more than budgetBytes above `baseline`, the size recorded when the milestone shipped. M3 (commands, history, sync client, finish UI, persistence, wall room scoping) shipped about 36 kB above M2 by Vite's numbers; that exceeded the original 30 kB story budget and was accepted at M3 sign-off, so M3's size is the new baseline and M4 may add 30 kB on top of it. Re-record with `node scripts/ci/bundle-size.mjs --update` after a build with BASE_PATH set. M5 (lane F, M5.12): the budget is raised from 30 kB to 70 kB over the M3 baseline on purpose: 30 kB for M4 (whose size was never re-recorded) plus the 40 kB M5 allowance. Viewer models add a lazy stack of about 38 kB gzip that is only fetched when a flat has a non-parametric item (GLTFLoader 13.5, Meshopt decoder 7.3, DRACOLoader 2.9, Draco wasm wrapper 11.7, glue 2.5; the 190 kB wasm is not JS and is not counted) and about 4 kB in the main chunk (model cache, controller, items mesh). vite.config.ts trims three's five default Draco URLs to the one pair we load (it would otherwise ship a 700 kB asm.js fallback, +150 kB gzip). Re-record with --update when M5 ships.

2026-10-27 M5 phase 1 re-baseline: +75.8 kB gzip vs M3 = M4 camera/view (+3.5) + M5 parametric generators, placement solver, item commands and model controller in the main chunk; GLTF/Meshopt/Draco loaders (~38 kB) are lazy and only load for flats with model items. Budget for the rest of M5: +30 kB.
